bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
log=/tmp/video-two-build-20261124.log
test -s "$log" || exit 71
if grep -q 'ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE' "$log"; then exit 91; fi
if grep -q 'ERR_PNPM_FETCH' "$log"; then exit 92; fi
if grep -q 'ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION' "$log"; then exit 93; fi
if grep -q 'ERR_PNPM_UNSUPPORTED_ENGINE' "$log"; then exit 94; fi
if grep -q 'ERR_PNPM_WORKSPACE_PKG_NOT_FOUND' "$log"; then exit 95; fi
if grep -Eiq 'Unable to find|could not find|package.json|ENOENT|not found' "$log"; then exit 96; fi
if grep -Eiq 'corepack|signature|npm registry|TLS|certificate' "$log"; then exit 97; fi
if grep -Eiq 'ERR_PNPM|pnpm install' "$log"; then exit 98; fi
exit 99
